transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As we discussed previously, the school's annual emergency evacuation exercise needs to be completed during the fall term, and I'm responsible for giving final approval to the exercise plan. The draft plan we have calls for a standard evacuation alarm, assembly in the east courtyard, and a general family notice. Before I can approve it, school policy requires me to review the plan with the nurse, counselor, facilities manager, and family liaison. I'd like to get all of your input today so we can finalize this. Let's start with the facilities manager -- do you see any issues with the east courtyard as our assembly point?
